question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class expanded composer modal to Control UI, or address long-prompt friction through inline growth/resizing and send-shortcut preferences instead?
rationale: The request is valuable and aligned with web-frontend ergonomics, but it adds a new compose mode whose draft, keyboard, focus, attachment, and send semantics need product intent before implementation.

options.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
options.body: Add the requested Expand action and large editor modal with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, and modal-specific keyboard behavior while preserving the inline composer contract.

options.title: Prefer Inline Composer Improvements
options.body: Resolve the friction through auto-grow, resizing, and shortcut affordances without adding a second draft-editing surface.

options.title: Fold Into Shortcut Work
options.body: Keep this issue blocked behind the WebChat send-shortcut direction and revisit only after that interaction model is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
recommendation.body: Add the requested Expand action and large editor modal with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, and modal-specific keyboard behavior while preserving the inline composer contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current signal from the prior issue review and recent adjacent composer UI work.
